name: Hardlight Local Checks
description: Local opaque-sRGB contrast and declared navigation-graph checks. Stateless, bounded and advisory; no network, credentials or filesystem access.
author: Mercury; adapted from Seth Wilson and Hardlight UI contributors

tools.name: contrast
tools.description: Measure explicit opaque sRGB foreground/background pairs for text, large text or UI. Not a WCAG conformance audit.

tools.name: navigation
tools.description: Check a declared page graph for shortest task paths, missing links, ambiguous labels and unreachable pages. Not usability certification.
